systems.system: Electronic population register of each zoba
systems.country_label: electronic population register; its reference number is the ASC number
systems.owner: the zoba (regional) administrations; there is no national population register
systems.tiers: one per zoba in all six, first in zoba Maekel in 2003; the sub-zoba administrations update the databases, enter births, marriages and deaths and issue print-outs

systems.system: Handwritten family register of the kebabi
systems.tiers: every kebabi, about 2,000, the lowest administrative level; data passes to the sub-zoba by a paper transfer letter

systems.system: Civil registry of the municipality of Asmara
systems.tiers: zoba Maekel; issues birth, marriage, divorce and death certificates

note: The note describes registers, not connections: sub-zoba offices key events into the zoba's electronic population register and kebabi offices keep handwritten registers and send paper transfer letters. It does not say the sub-zoba offices are networked or work online, so no connection fact is recorded; the parent may wish to check that reading.
